description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_1d_dirichlet_central.esm (model Advection, test mms_steady_dirichlet_central) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered fixed-value (Dirichlet) first-derivative rule central_D1_dirichlet_bc (mirror-ghost faces, nonzero walls gL=1, gR=e^2) as the advective term of a well-posed advection-diffusion decay problem (the diffusion supplies the boundary dissipation that makes a two-sided fixed-value gradient well posed; see the problem metadata). The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
